title: TCPA Opt-Out Requirements: Pick Your Method From November 25
meta_description: From 25 November 2026 callers may name exclusive opt-out methods if every call or text discloses them. AI sales calls keep the two-second opt-out.
secondary_keywords: ai voice agent opt out requirements

image.takeaway: From 25 November 2026 callers may pick the opt-outs they honor. AI sales calls keep the in-call opt-out.
image.alt: TCPA opt-out requirements from 25 November 2026: callers may name exclusive opt-out methods if every call or text discloses them, while AI sales calls keep the automated in-call opt-out and the do-not-call list
